sloka: निर्वृतो भव काकुत्स्थ सो ऽस्मिन्नहनि बालकः ।जीवितं प्राप्तवान्भूयः समेतश्चापि बन्धुभिः ।। ७.७६.१४ ॥
transliteration: nirvṛto bhava kākutstha so 'sminnahani bālakaḥ ।jīvitaṁ prāptavānbhūyaḥ sametaścāpi bandhubhiḥ ।। 7.76.14 ॥

translations.english: O Kakutstha, be relieved, for that boy has regained his life and is reunited with his relatives this very day.
